interpretation.ordinaryHooks: mask ordinary requests, history and tool results in tested cases
interpretation.background: generic context/payload hooks skipped by manual/automatic compaction and tree summaries
interpretation.hookErrors: throw/rejection alone fails open in these host callbacks
interpretation.explicitAbort: ctx.abort stops tested ordinary requests on all three APIs
interpretation.specializedCancellation: cancel result stops manual/automatic compaction and tree summaries
interpretation.wire: existing fetch guard masks normal and background requests, masks late additions, refuses forced errors/size limits

limitations: loopback stubs, not real provider availability or incident frequency
SDK AgentSession used for branch navigation; interactive TUI not exercised
hook prototypes only substitute a synthetic canary; they do not implement production mapping/restoration
abort race/retry variations, model switches, OAuth, non-fetch transports, Windows and multiple pi versions not covered
forced wire-error injects a throwing Core to test the real fetch wrapper; over-limit uses the real Core
